journal:
# Mohammed (p11) journal

## Day 1 (Mon 2027-01-11)
- Setup was easy. Picked Lightly active, male formula, "Yes" I've been eating the same for 2+ weeks (I want to keep 82 kg).
- Setup already asked my current weight (82), then Progress showed 82 kg. I didn't know that counted as a weigh-in, so I also tapped + Weight and saved 82. At the bottom under "Recent entries" there were TWO 2027-01-11 weight 82 kg rows. Confusing: the profile weight silently became a weigh-in. The rows show no time, so I couldn't tell which was which; deleted one. (screens/1790454658285.png)
- Food log has only a Date, no time for each meal. Fine for now, but I wonder how suhoor after midnight in Ramadan will work.
- Logged 4 meals (2739 kcal) and ticked "Day complete". Nutrition: maintenance 2,460 ± 580, target 2,460 "maintain", "Estimated, 0% from your data". Good - matches what I want (stay stable). I ate ~280 over today but it's one day.
- The iPhone "Add to Home Screen" banner - tapped Got it.

## Day 2 (Tue 2027-01-12)
- Weighed 82, 4 meals (2370 kcal), marked complete. Routine is quick now.
- Nutrition page has a day list that goes back to 12-30 showing "not logged" for days before I even installed the app. A bit odd, looks like I missed days.

## Day 3 (Wed 2027-01-13)
- 81.5 kg (▼0.5 vs first). Trend weight still says 82 - fine, it's smoothing.
- Recommendation card still says "An on-track check needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)" even though this is my 3rd day of logging. I guess it only counts on the weekly update (Monday), but "day 1 so far" reads like it isn't counting my days.
- 4 meals 2282 kcal, complete.

## Day 4 (Thu 2027-01-14)
- 82.6 kg (up 1.1 from yesterday - water I guess). 4 meals 2596 kcal, complete.
- Nutrition: avg intake 2,497 vs target 2,460. Close enough. Carbs/fat targets shown (~361 g carbs, >=55 g fat). "Maintenance is still mostly the formula estimate" - ok, understood.
## Day 5: 82.3 kg, 4 meals 2351 kcal, complete. Nothing new.
## Day 6: no weigh-in, 4 meals 2405 kcal, complete.
## Day 7 (Sun 2027-01-17)
- 82.4 kg. 4 meals 2255 kcal; the pasta dinner only had kcal and protein on the label, and the app took it fine (shows "44P").
- 7/7 days complete, avg intake 2,428.
- Looked at settings (gear on Nutrition): only Goal Lose/Maintain/Gain + protein. Goal is Maintain. Nothing about Ramadan or when a "day" starts/ends - I'm a bit worried since suhoor is after midnight.

## Week 1 (checked Sun 2027-01-17, night)
- App says: maintenance 2,460 ± 580 kcal/day, target 2,460 "maintain", label Estimated, 0% from my data. Recommendation: "Suggested intake: 2,460 kcal/day. An on-track check needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)". No warnings. Body composition: "Not enough data yet".
- Explain the math: honest but very technical (Kalman filter, Forbes, Hall 2008...). I understood: it's still just the formula (Mifflin x 1.375) and will learn from my data over time. The ± 580 is huge.
- My avg 2,428 is basically the target and my weight is flat (82 -> 82.4). I'll keep eating like this. No plan change.

## Day 8 (Mon 2027-01-18) - Monday update
- From today I use my own little script (auto.mjs) that types my meals/weigh-ins into the app. Same taps.
- Weekly update: maintenance 2,400 ± 550, target 2,400 maintain, Estimated, 8% from my data. kg/week +0.03 (95% -0.57 to 0.64). Target dropped by 60 kcal. Fine, I'm at ~2,400 anyway.

## Week 2 (checked Sun 2027-01-24)
- Days 9-14 logged by my script, all complete. Weigh-ins 81.3 / 82.4 / 82.2 / 81.6. Trend weight 82 kg.
- App: maintenance 2,400 ± 550 (from Mon update), target 2,400 maintain, Estimated, 8% from my data. My 7-day avg 2,492, kg/week +0.03. Still "An on-track check needs 14 days of data (day 8 so far)" - so the counter only moves on Mondays.
- One day (Thu) I didn't know the breakfast macros so I entered kcal only - protein now says "average of 5 complete day(s) with protein logged" even though 7 days are complete. Makes sense, but slightly surprising.
- Understanding: weight is flat, I'm eating about at maintenance. No change. Ramadan is coming soon, that's the real test.

## Day 15 (Mon 2027-01-25) update
- 'On track' now. Maintenance 2,470 ± 470, target 2,470, 35% from my data, -0.19 kg/week. Good.

## Week 3 (checked Sun 2027-01-31)
- Days 16-21 all logged + complete, weighed every day (81.5-82.4). Trend 81.9.
- App: "On track. Your estimated rate (-0.77 to +0.39 kg/week) includes your target of +0 kg/week. Suggested intake 2,470." Maintenance 2,470 ± 470, Estimated, 35% from my data. My 7-day avg intake 2,600 (130 above), yet weight flat.
- My take: I'm stable, which is exactly what I want. Eating 2,600 and not gaining - maybe my labels are a bit high, or maintenance is a bit higher. No change to eating.

## Day 22 (Mon 2027-02-01) update
- Now 'Measured', 63% from my data. Maintenance 2,500 ± 350, target 2,500, on track (+0.05 kg/week). The label switched from Estimated to Measured - I like that.

## Week 4 (checked Sun 2027-02-07)
- Days 23-28 logged and complete; weighed 6 of 7 days (skipped Sun). Weights 82.2, 82.7, 83.1, 81.7, 81.8. Trend 82.1.
- App: On track (-0.31 to +0.41 kg/week), maintenance 2,500 ± 350, target 2,500, Measured, 63% from my data. My 7-day avg intake 2,735.
- New: two notes "2027-02-04: macros add up to ~3306 kcal vs 2704 kcal logged (22% apart). One of the numbers may be off." and same for 02-06 (15%). I opened 02-04: the entries are exactly what I typed from my apps/labels. Nice that it checks, but it doesn't say which meal is off, and I can't really fix a restaurant shawarma estimate. I'll leave it.
- Decision: no change. Ramadan starts this week - I expect the eating pattern to change completely (iftar + suhoor). Target 2,500 is my guide.

## Day 29 (Mon 2027-02-08) - Ramadan starts
- Monday update: On track, maintenance 2,520 ± 290, target 2,520, Measured 76%.
- Weighed 82 at 06:50. Iftar 18:00 (1,952 kcal), dessert & tea 21:30 (279). I ticked 2027-02-08 complete at 21:30 because in my head the fasting day of the 8th is over; tonight's suhoor belongs to tomorrow's fast.
- SUHOOR at 03:30 (clock 2027-02-09 03:30): opened + Food, the Date field showed **2027-02-09**. That's what I expected - suhoor is part of the fast of the 9th that starts at dawn. MATCHED. The day list then showed "Today 1 entry 711 kcal open" and 02-08 = 2,231 complete.
- Little worry: there's no time on food entries and no "Ramadan mode", so I just trust the calendar date. The macro-mismatch note now appears on almost every entry I type (my app estimates are rough).
- From now my script logs suhoor with `time 03:30 next` and records the date the form shows.

## Days 30-35 (Ramadan week 1)
- Every suhoor I logged at 03:30 landed on the NEXT calendar date (the fasting day that starts at dawn): 02-09 suhoor -> 2027-02-10, -> 02-11, -> 02-12, -> 02-13, -> 02-14, -> 02-15. Matches what I expect every time. Each day in the list = suhoor (early morning) + iftar + dessert, and I tick "Day complete" after the 21:30 dessert.
- Script hiccup on my side (day 32) - not the app.

## Week 5 (checked at suhoor, Mon 2027-02-15 03:30)
- Banner: "It's been 30+ days since your last backup. Back up now / Later". Tapped Back up now -> "Your data" window (weigh-ins 30, food entries 133, complete days 35, "Persistent storage: not granted by the browser"). Downloaded Full backup JSON (downloads/bodytracker-backup-2027-02-15.json). Last backup now 2027-02-15.
- Recommendation: On track (-0.70 to +0.72 kg/week), suggested 2,550. Maintenance 2,550 ± 260, Measured 79%. 7-day avg 2,683, +0.01 kg/week. Warning: 02-12 macros vs kcal 15% apart.
- NOTICE: because I opened the app at 03:30 on Monday for suhoor, the "weekly Monday update" already happened then ("last update 2027-02-15, day 36"), before my Monday morning weigh-in and with today being only the suhoor (open day, "6/7 complete"). The rate range got much wider (was -0.14..+0.45 last week, now -0.70..+0.72). I wonder if it's because it ran at 3:30am on a half day. I'll check after I weigh.
- My take: Ramadan is going fine, weight 81.6-82.5, flat. Eating ~2,600-2,900 per fasting day. Keep going.

## Day 36 (Mon 2027-02-15)
- After I weighed (81.6) and logged iftar/dessert, the Monday numbers were different from what I read at 03:30: now On track (-0.17 to +0.34), suggested 2,580, maintenance 2,580 ± 240, 83% - still "last update 2027-02-15". So what I saw at suhoor time was a half-baked version of the Monday update that got replaced later the same day. Not harmful, but if I had written down/acted on the 03:30 numbers they'd be different. For someone who opens the app at suhoor, "the Monday update" happens in the middle of the night.
- Suhoor 885 kcal (only kcal+protein known) -> date 2027-02-16. As expected.

## Days 37-42 (Ramadan week 2)
- All suhoors again landed on the next calendar date (02-17 ... 02-22), as I expect. All days complete, weighed every morning: 82.4, 81.0, 81.5, 81.5, 81.4, 81.3.

## Week 6 (checked at suhoor, Mon 2027-02-22 03:30)
- App: On track, rate -0.37 to +0.03 kg/week, suggested 2,660. Maintenance 2,660 ± 190, Measured 89%. My 7-day avg intake 2,439, -0.17 kg/week. Trend weight 81.7 (started 82). No warnings.
- My take: in Ramadan I'm eating ~200 below maintenance and slowly drifting down. The app still says "On track" because 0 is inside the range, but only just. I want to hold 82, so I'll eat a bit more (bigger suhoor): plan 2,650.
- (Again this is the 03:30 version of the Monday update; I'll glance later today.)

## Days 43-49 (Ramadan week 3)
- Day 43 (Mon) 03:30 vs later that day: this time the Monday numbers barely changed (2,660 ± 190 both times).
- Day 44 (Tue): life log says I didn't weigh. All suhoors again on the next date (02-23 ... 03-01). All days complete.

## Week 7 (checked at suhoor, Mon 2027-03-01 03:30)
- Recommendation changed: "Your estimated rate (-0.43 to -0.04 kg per week) doesn't include your target of +0 kg/week. Eating about 220 kcal/day more than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 2,710 kcal/day." Maintenance 2,710 ± 180, Measured 90%. 7-day avg 2,603, -0.24 kg/week.
- Body: "Trend weight 81.4 kg · 1 weigh-in ignored (tap Weight to review)". Weight trend chart shows 2027-02-25: 82.8 kg flagged "1.6 kg from the 7-day median", grey dot, with a "Use it" button. It was a real reading (big iftar the night before, salty food) so the app's "unusual water swing" guess is right - I left it ignored.
- Hmm: my plan from last week (2,650) wasn't enough; the maintenance number keeps creeping up (2,460 -> 2,660 -> 2,710). The advice is clear and specific ("~220 kcal more"), which I like. Plan: 2,720.

## Days 50-56 (Ramadan week 4)
- Day 50 no weigh-in (life log). Weights 81.9, 81.8, 81.5, 82.1, 83.0, 82.4. Suhoors: every one on the next calendar date (03-02 ... 03-08). All days complete.

## Week 8 (checked at suhoor, Mon 2027-03-08 03:30)
- App: On track (-0.15 to +0.22 kg/week). Suggested 2,600, maintenance 2,600 ± 170, Measured 91%. 7-day avg 2,556, +0.03 kg/week. Trend 81.8 kg. Still "1 weigh-in ignored" (the 02-25 one).
- My take: the extra food worked, weight is back to flat. Funny that maintenance went down from 2,710 to 2,600 in one week - the number moves around by 100 kcal each week, which is within its ± so fine. Following it: plan 2,600.

## Days 57-63 (Eid, back to normal)
- Day 57 (Mon 03-08): "Ramadan is over - Eid! Back to normal meals." The last suhoor (03:30 on 03-08) sits on 03-08 together with the normal breakfast/lunch/snack/dinner -> 03-08 shows 5 entries, 3,221 kcal. That's correct (I did eat all of it that calendar day), but it's the day my "fasting day" model and the app's calendar day disagree: that suhoor was for a fast that turned out to be Eid. No way in the app to say so; not a big deal.
- Days without weigh-in: 03-10. Weights 81.1, 81.3, 81.0, 81.5, 82.5, 82.2.

## Week 9 (checked Sun 2027-03-14 night)
- App: On track (-0.19 to +0.17 kg/week), suggested 2,640, maintenance 2,640 ± 170, Measured 91%. 7/7 complete, avg 2,671, -0.01 kg/week.
- Again: "last update 2027-03-08" but the numbers differ from what I saw on 03-08 at 03:30 (2,600 then, 2,640 now). The Monday update keeps changing for the rest of that Monday. As a suhoor person I always see the early version first.
- Decision: I'm right on target. No change.

## Week 10 (checked Sun 2027-03-21 night)
- Weighed every day this week: 82.3, 81.9, 81.8, 82.2, 81.4, 82.2, 82.1. Trend 81.8. All days complete.
- App: On track (-0.11 to +0.26), suggested 2,600, maintenance 2,600 ± 170, Measured 92%. Avg 2,661, +0.08 kg/week. Macro warning for 03-17 (20% apart).
- Backup banner again ("30+ days since your last backup", last one was 02-15 - correct). Tapped Later; I'll do it at the end of the month.
- Decision: fine as is.

## Week 11 (checked Sun 2027-03-28 night)
- Weighed every day: 81.5, 82.3, 82.5, 82.5, 82.2, 82.7, 82.2. Trend 82.1. All complete.
- App: On track (-0.11 to +0.25), suggested 2,610, maintenance 2,610 ± 160, Measured 92%. Avg 2,711, +0.07 kg/week. Macro warning 03-22.
- Decision: eating a touch above but weight flat at 82. No change.

## Week 12 (checked Sun 2027-04-04 night, last day)
- App: On track (-0.02 to +0.35 kg/week), suggested 2,550, maintenance 2,550 ± 170, Measured 92%. 7-day avg 2,851 (!), +0.16 kg/week. Trend 82.3. Body composition still "Not enough data yet" (I never entered body fat or tape, fair).
- My take: I've been eating ~300 over the suggestion since Eid and weight is creeping up a little. "On track" but just barely. Plan 2,600 (trim portions).

## Backup & export (2027-04-04)
- ⇩ -> Your data: weigh-ins 75, food entries 308, complete days 84, last backup 2027-02-15.
- Full backup JSON: downloads/bodytracker-backup-2027-04-04.json - all 75 weigh-ins, 308 food entries, day flags, settings. Inside, meta.lastBackupAt still says 2027-02-15 (the file doesn't know it is itself the new backup) - harmless.
- Daily export (All data, with food entries): downloads/bodytracker-daily_2027-01-11_to_2027-04-04.json - one row per day, 84 days, clean. Food CSV also fine.
- Ramadan check in the export: every suhoor sits on the calendar date it was eaten (= the fasting day it belongs to in my mind), e.g. 2027-02-09 = Suhoor 711 + Iftar 1067 + Dessert 163. 2027-03-08 (Eid) = last suhoor + 4 normal meals = 3,221.
- Food entries have no time of day, in the app or in the files, so nothing shows that the suhoor was at 03:30.
- Daily totals leave out protein/carbs/fat when any meal that day had no macros (e.g. 2027-01-21 and 2027-03-08 have calories only, even though most meals had macros). A bit surprising in a spreadsheet.

## Final review
Honestly this worked for me through Ramadan better than I expected. I was worried that suhoor at 3:30am would land on the wrong day, but the app just uses the calendar date. For me that's the right answer, because suhoor belongs to the fast that starts at dawn, and all 28 suhoors went where I wanted. I didn't have to think about it. The weekly number getting more confident (Estimated 0% -> Measured 92%, ± 580 -> ± 170) felt honest, and when I was drifting down in Ramadan it told me plainly "eat about 220 kcal more", which fixed it in a week. Complaints: the Monday update happens at whatever time I first open the app on Monday, which in Ramadan is 3:30am before I've weighed. Those numbers then changed later that day while still saying "last update" with the same date. The profile weight quietly became a duplicate weigh-in on day 1. The macro-mismatch notes nag about restaurant estimates I can't fix. "Explain the math" is too technical for me. There's also no time on meals, and no Ramadan/fasting option. I'd keep using it.
agentReply:
# p11 Mohammed: final reply

## 1. Usage
- I used the app on all 84 days (2027-01-11 to 2027-04-04). From day 8 a script in my folder did the taps (auto.mjs).
- I logged 308 meals: 4 a day outside Ramadan. During Ramadan it was iftar, dessert & tea, and a suhoor at 03:30.
- All 84 days are marked complete.
- I weighed in 75 times. On day 1 there was also one duplicate, which I deleted.

## Suhoor dates (Ramadan: days 29–56, 2027-02-08 to 03-07)
I entered each suhoor at 03:30 after midnight (`time 03:30 next`). The Date field on the food form always showed the **new calendar date**:
- The 02-08 night's suhoor went to 02-09, the 02-09 night's to 02-10, and so on, one day later each time, ending with the 03-07 night's suhoor on 03-08. That's 28 of 28.
- This is what I expected every time: suhoor belongs to the fasting day that starts at dawn.
- So each Ramadan day in the app holds that morning's suhoor plus the iftar and dessert from the same evening. I ticked each day complete after the 21:30 dessert.
- One edge case: the last suhoor (03-08) was eaten before the fast that turned out to be Eid. It sits on 03-08 with 4 normal meals, 3,221 kcal in 5 entries. That's correct by the calendar, but it's the one time my "fasting day" idea didn't fit.

## 2. Weekly table
| wk | maintenance shown | target | label | recommendation | what I did |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 2,460 ± 580 | 2,460 maintain | Estimated 0% | Suggested 2,460; on-track check needs 14 days | nothing |
| 2 | 2,400 ± 550 | 2,400 | Estimated 8% | same, "day 8 so far" | nothing |
| 3 | 2,470 ± 470 | 2,470 | Estimated 35% | On track (−0.77..+0.39) | nothing |
| 4 | 2,500 ± 350 | 2,500 | Measured 63% | On track + macro-mismatch notes 02-04, 02-06 | nothing |
| 5 | 2,550 ± 260 at 03:30, later 2,580 ± 240 | same | Measured 79%, later 83% | On track; 30-day backup banner | made a backup |
| 6 | 2,660 ± 190 | 2,660 | Measured 89% | On track (−0.37..+0.03) | plan 2,650 |
| 7 | 2,710 ± 180 | 2,710 | Measured 90% | Off target: "eat ~220 kcal/day more" | plan 2,720 |
| 8 | 2,600 ± 170 at 03:30, later 2,640 | same | Measured 91% | On track | plan 2,600 |
| 9 | 2,640 ± 170 | 2,640 | Measured 91% | On track | nothing |
| 10 | 2,600 ± 170 | 2,600 | Measured 92% | On track; backup banner | tapped Later |
| 11 | 2,610 ± 160 | 2,610 | Measured 92% | On track | nothing |
| 12 | 2,550 ± 170 | 2,550 | Measured 92% | On track (−0.02..+0.35); I averaged 2,851 | plan 2,600 |

## 3. Confusions
- **Profile setup / Recent entries:** the profile's "Current weight" silently became a weigh-in. When I then added mine I had two 82 kg entries on 01-11, with no times shown to tell them apart.
- **Recommendation card:** it said "on-track check needs 14 days (day 1 so far)" on days 2–7, while I was logging daily. It only counts on the Monday update.
- **Nutrition day list:** it shows "not logged" for dates before I installed the app.
- **Monday update in Ramadan:** it ran when I opened the app for suhoor at 03:30, before my weigh-in and with the new day holding only the suhoor. Later that Monday the numbers changed (2,550 → 2,580, 2,600 → 2,640) but it still said "last update" with the same date.
- **Macro-mismatch notes:** they appear on most days with restaurant estimates and don't say which meal is off.
- **Explain the math:** too technical (Kalman filter, Forbes, MAD).
- **Food log:** meals have no time and there is no fasting or Ramadan option, so I just had to trust the date field.
- **Daily export:** it drops the protein, carbs and fat totals for any day where one meal had no macros (e.g. 01-21, 03-08).

## 4. Possible bugs
1. **Duplicate weigh-in on day 1.** Steps: onboard with current weight 82, then + Weight 82 on the same day. Expected: the profile weight is either the first weigh-in (with a hint) or kept separate. Actual: two identical 01-11 · 82 kg entries. Screenshot: screens/1790454658285.png
2. **Monday update locks in (or changes) at the first open after midnight.** Steps: open the app Monday at 03:30, look at the Nutrition card, then weigh at 06:50 and log food. Expected: one stable weekly number per week, or an update timed after the morning weigh-in. Actual: the numbers change during Monday while still saying "last update 2027-02-15". On 02-15 at 03:30 it showed 2,550 ± 260 with a rate of −0.70..+0.72; later it showed 2,580 ± 240 with −0.17..+0.34. Screenshot: screens/1790455706752.png
3. **Minor: backup file's last-backup date.** The backup made on 04-04 has `meta.lastBackupAt: "2027-02-15"` (the previous backup) inside it.

No other crashes or wrong dates.

## 5. Review
Through Ramadan this was better than I feared: every 3:30am suhoor landed on the fasting day I'd put it on, with no setting needed. When I drifted down it told me clearly to eat about 220 kcal more, and that fixed it. What I'd fix: the "weekly" number gets made at suhoor time and then changes, there's a duplicate weigh-in at setup, and the macro warnings nag. A Ramadan mode or meal times would make me trust it fully.

**Would keep using: yes**
